_note: Demo content for the demo front door on the Swiss server. The first seven items are fictional (no real person, no real address); the eight items that follow are the owner's own public lines, ticked allow-in-advance and verbatim (apps/trustweb/src/demo_inventory_public.ts; two further public lines are longer than the 160 characters this service keeps and stay in the app demo only). audience: fof = friends of friends (every asker of this peer is an acquaintance), friends = friends and close friends only, me = only me. A line is shared ONLY when it carries a preset (a permission the owner set in advance: by, at, note); the asker sees that mark next to the line. Lines without a preset are held and never shared by this service; the owner's phone decides them live when it is bound.
